description: Claude Code adapter for kith: your persistent specialist agents, with their memory and projects, as subagents in every session.

kith_path.title: kith folder
kith_path.description: Where the kith kernel lives. Empty: the installed CLI's kernel, ~/.kith/cli/current/share/kith/kernel (a developer sets KITH_KERNEL or this to a checkout's kernel/). Agents come from KITH_HOME (default ~/kith), state from ~/.kith.
